description: A grocery store wants to liquidate its stock of 10 apples, 20 bananas, and 80 grapes. Given past experience, the store knows that they can propose a banana-haters package with 6 apples and 30 grapes and that this package will bring a profit of six euros. Similarly, they can prepare a combo package with 5 apples, 6 bananas, and 20 grapes, yielding a profit of seven euros. They know they can sell any quantity of these two packages within the availability of its stock. What quantity of each package, banana-haters packages and combo packages, should the store prepare to maximize net profit?

NumItems.definition: Number of different items to be liquidated

Required.definition: Amount of each item required to prepare one unit of each package

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit obtained from preparing and selling the banana-haters and combo packages."
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    PackageProfit[0] * BananaHatersPackages + 
    PackageProfit[1] * ComboPackages,
    GRB.MAXIMIZE
)

constraints.description: The total number of apples used in all packages should not exceed the 10 apples available (6 × BananaHatersPackages + 5 × ComboPackages ≤ 10)
The number of Banana-haters packages prepared must be non-negative (BananaHatersPackages ≥ 0)
The number of Combo packages prepared must be non-negative (ComboPackages ≥ 0)

BananaHatersPackages.definition: Number of banana-haters packages to prepare

ComboPackages.definition: Number of combo packages to prepare
